proposed_enforcement: Fresh separately permissioned private-by-default implementation repository and pinned branch; never current research repo
detection: Repo identity or branch scope does not match signed AP-01
future_independent_evidence: Owner-signed exact repo/branch; repository settings screenshot or API record

proposed_enforcement: Developer limited write to mock branch; owner signs; custodian rights only; QA read-only distinct actor
detection: Developer and reviewer same identity or broad token
future_independent_evidence: Permission matrix and distinct reviewer attestation

proposed_enforcement: Zero default originals; exact signed per-file path/ref/digest and allowed purpose
detection: File absent from AP-02 manifest
future_independent_evidence: Signed manifest with zero default and denial log

proposed_enforcement: No source writes; immutable staging; import only exact file; compare before/after
detection: Staged bytes differ or directory writable
future_independent_evidence: Read-only mount/ACL and double-digest receipt

proposed_enforcement: No wildcard clone/includes/links/submodules/LFS/archives; block escaping normalized paths
detection: Unexpected path, target or URL resolution
future_independent_evidence: Static input gate inspection and malicious link fixtures

proposed_enforcement: Deny DNS and outbound TCP/UDP at environment and tool layers; no CI/telemetry
detection: Network request or unapproved egress path
future_independent_evidence: Firewall policy and isolated negative network checks

proposed_enforcement: No payment credentials nor provider SDK/client/tool connections; no spend authorized
detection: Billable endpoint or account credential found
future_independent_evidence: Credential-absence inventory and owner billing check

proposed_enforcement: Fictional source records and examples; no real events; synthetic flag and non-publish label
detection: Real source or source-rich text detected in fixtures
future_independent_evidence: Fixture inventory and manual content provenance review

proposed_enforcement: Untrusted prose never becomes instructions; inert parser; no content-derived tool actions
detection: Embedded command/URL asks policy bypass
future_independent_evidence: Synthetic injection suite and reviewer tool-call trace

proposed_enforcement: No SSH/API keys, provider credentials or personal secrets mounted; redact any diagnostic
detection: Canary token or credential found
future_independent_evidence: ACL and redacted inventory without disclosing secrets

proposed_enforcement: Git commit+blob+SHA256+UTF8-byte-length pin; verify staged bytes before and after
detection: Any identifier, size or digest mismatch
future_independent_evidence: Paired hashed file receipt and resolved ref

proposed_enforcement: Pinned preinstalled offline stdlib runtime preferred; no auto package/extension install
detection: Resolver, update hook, untrusted binary or network dependency
future_independent_evidence: Runtime provenance, SBOM when applicable and offline checks

proposed_enforcement: Revision-aware dependency graph invalidates facts, topic lock, title, draft and approvals
detection: Source revision, timestamp or rights status changed
future_independent_evidence: Change-impact ledger and fresh independent signoffs

proposed_enforcement: Only synthetic IDs/statuses, bounded digests and timestamps; owner retention and cleanup
detection: Raw content in logs or records kept past expiry
future_independent_evidence: Redacted schema, retention policy and cleanup receipt

proposed_enforcement: Validate signed scope per run; instant stop and no renewal by inference
detection: Expired grant or explicit owner withdrawal
future_independent_evidence: Dated stop record and revocation/deletion evidence

proposed_enforcement: Named non-author reviewer gets snapshot and synthetic audit-only, no developer self-approval
detection: Matching author/reviewer or mutable initial verdict
future_independent_evidence: Review identity, immutable initial verdict and subsequent adjudication trail

proposed_enforcement: A10 production_allowed=false; no RELEASED transition, deployment token or production workflows
detection: Release call, live publishing artifact or SKILL.md requested
future_independent_evidence: Negative release-gate assessment, absence of deployment permissions

proposed_enforcement: AP-00 planning only; signed AP-01 for build; separately signed AP-02 item rights and transfer; no waiver
detection: Only draft/recommendation/public visibility presented as approval
future_independent_evidence: Signature authenticity, per-file custodian and owner approval ledger

scope_requirement: Source role and model output quarantine
proposed_enforcement: Mock A01-A10 and N01-N05; preserve all native HOLD codes and synthetic status
detection: Unverified source promoted to evidence; critical waiver
future_independent_evidence: Fictional negative tests mapped to original QA IDs, no execution claim

scope_requirement: CI cloud sync and extension hardening
proposed_enforcement: No GitHub Actions/deploy automation or editor telemetry; cloud sync disabled or isolated and proven
detection: Workflow, extension update, crash upload or sync path enabled
future_independent_evidence: Settings and outbound-network review by independent assessor
